shared: aspartate family amino acid biosynthetic process

reading_1.theme: One-carbon folate-methionine metabolism and nucleotide synthesis
reading_1.core_role: The shared pathways are the folate and methionine/SAM one-carbon cycle, framed as the supplier of one-carbon units for de novo purine and thymidylate synthesis and nucleotide metabolism.

reading_2.theme: One-carbon folate-methionine cycle and sulfur amino acid metabolism
reading_2.core_role: The shared pathways describe folate interconversion, methionine synthesis and salvage and SAM/SAH metabolism, framed here as the methyl-donor cycle that feeds homocysteine into transsulfuration, cysteine and glutathione synthesis and selenium metabolism.

shared: negative regulation of D-glucose import across plasma membrane
positive regulation of D-glucose import across plasma membrane
positive regulation of cellular response to insulin stimulus

reading_1.theme: Insulin and adipokine control of glucose and lipid metabolism
reading_1.core_role: The shared pathways are insulin sensitivity, adiponectin signalling and glucose import into cells, framed as the output layer of hormonal (insulin/IGF, glucagon/PKA, AMPK) regulation of systemic fuel storage and use.

reading_2.theme: Insulin and adiponectin control of glucose and fuel storage
reading_2.core_role: The shared pathways cover adiponectin signalling and control of insulin-stimulated glucose uptake, i.e. insulin sensitivity. This node sits within insulin and glucagon/PKA hormonal control of glycogen and triglyceride metabolism.

reading_1.theme: Heavy metal and zinc homeostasis via transporters and metallothioneins
reading_1.core_role: The shared pathways concern cellular responses to and detoxification of toxic metals (cadmium, mercury), understood here as handled by the same MTF1-metallothionein and zinc-transporter machinery that maintains zinc and copper homeostasis.

reading_2.theme: Heavy metal and zinc homeostasis and detoxification
reading_2.core_role: The shared pathways describe cadmium and mercury transport and detoxification, framed as toxic-metal handling through the same zinc transporter, metallothionein and MTF1 machinery that maintains zinc homeostasis.

shared: Erythrocytes take up carbon dioxide and release oxygen
Erythrocytes take up oxygen and release carbon dioxide
Defective RHAG causes regulator type Rh-null hemolytic anemia (RHN)

reading_1.theme: Erythrocyte gas exchange and ammonium/CO2 transport
reading_1.core_role: The shared pathways cover erythrocyte membrane and hemoglobin transport of oxygen, CO2, NO and ammonia, including through Rh/RHAG glycoproteins. Here this is respiratory gas and acid-base exchange, supported by carbonic anhydrase and lactate/MCT-basigin transport.

reading_2.theme: Erythrocyte gas and ammonium transport
reading_2.core_role: The shared pathways are red cell membrane transport of oxygen, carbon dioxide, nitric oxide and ammonium, including the Rh-associated glycoproteins and Rh-null disease, which link to carbonic anhydrase, ammonium homeostasis and basigin-chaperoned monocarboxylate transport.

shared: Uptake and function of diphtheria toxin
Uptake and function of anthrax toxins

reading_1.theme: Host–pathogen interaction in myeloid cells
reading_1.core_role: The shared pathways cover pathogen and toxin uptake, NADPH oxidase activation and anti-inflammatory macrophage responses, framed as myeloid and dendritic-cell host defence against microbes and protozoa with cytokine-tuned antigen presentation.

reading_2.theme: Host-pathogen interactions and bacterial toxin entry
reading_2.core_role: The shared pathways cover bacterial toxin uptake, anti-infective/anti-inflammatory host responses and NADPH oxidase activation, framed as host-pathogen interaction alongside bacterial attachment and invasion of host cells.

shared: positive regulation of attachment of mitotic spindle microtubules to kinetochore

reading_1.theme: Anaphase spindle midzone and cytokinesis
reading_1.core_role: The shared pathways are anaphase spindle mechanics (spindle elongation, midzone assembly, kinetochore attachment), framed as the structure that positions and signals Rho GTPase-driven cytokinesis.

reading_2.theme: Anaphase spindle midzone and cytokinesis
reading_2.core_role: The shared pathways describe spindle midzone assembly, spindle elongation and kinetochore attachment, framed as the mitotic spindle events that position and drive Rho GTPase-dependent cytokinesis.

shared: Thrombin signalling through proteinase activated receptors (PARs)

reading_1.theme: Platelet activation and blood coagulation
reading_1.core_role: The shared pathways describe platelet activation by thrombin and ADP receptors and platelet degranulation, the cellular arm of hemostasis that works together with coagulation, VWF adhesion and fibrinolysis.

reading_2.theme: Platelet activation and blood coagulation (hemostasis)
reading_2.core_role: The shared pathways cover platelet activation by thrombin and ADP and degranulation, framed as the cellular arm of hemostasis coordinated with platelet adhesion, the coagulation cascade and fibrinolysis.

shared: SEMA3A-Plexin repulsion signaling by inhibiting Integrin adhesion
positive regulation of axon extension involved in axon guidance
obsolete neuron projection extension involved in neuron projection guidance

reading_1.theme: Axon guidance by repulsive and attractive cues
reading_1.core_role: The shared pathways are semaphorin-plexin and netrin signalling for axon extension and repulsion, framed as two of several guidance systems (with Slit-Robo and ephrins) that steer growth cones via Rho GTPases.

reading_2.theme: Axon guidance by netrin, semaphorin, Slit-Robo and ephrin cues
reading_2.core_role: The shared pathways are the netrin and Sema3A-plexin guidance-cue signalling that steers axon extension and repulsion, the core cue-receptor axis alongside which Slit-Robo, ephrin and Rho-GTPase growth-cone collapse machinery complete axon pathfinding.

reading_1.theme: Plasma lipoprotein metabolism and remodelling
reading_1.core_role: The shared pathways are LDL and HDL remodelling, the intravascular reshaping of cholesterol-carrying lipoproteins downstream of chylomicron and VLDL assembly, lipolysis and clearance.

reading_2.theme: Lipoprotein metabolism and intestinal lipid absorption
reading_2.core_role: The shared pathways describe LDL and HDL particle remodeling, framed as one stage of the lipoprotein life cycle running from dietary lipid absorption and chylomicron/VLDL assembly to lipase action and clearance.

shared: positive regulation of actin filament depolymerization
negative regulation of Arp2/3 complex-mediated actin nucleation
regulation of barbed-end actin filament capping
establishment or maintenance of cell polarity regulating cell shape

reading_1.theme: Rho GTPase-driven actin remodeling in cell migration
reading_1.core_role: The shared pathways cover actin filament structural dynamics (severing, capping, depolymerization, bundling, crosslinking, network formation). They form the cytoskeletal effector layer that Rho-family GTPases (RAC, CDC42, RHOA and others) direct to build lamellipodia, ruffles and motile protrusions.

reading_2.theme: Actin cytoskeleton remodelling by Rho GTPases
reading_2.core_role: The shared pathways cover actin nucleation control, severing, capping, crosslinking and bundling, framed as Rho-GTPase-directed cytoskeletal shaping of cell polarity and protrusions including filopodia and postsynaptic actin.

shared: positive regulation of activin receptor signaling pathway
ectopic germ cell programmed cell death

reading_1.theme: Gonadal development, germ cells and reproductive endocrinology
reading_1.core_role: The shared pathways describe germ cell specification, migration, proliferation and meiotic entry with activin/AMH signalling and Leydig differentiation, framed as gonadal germline and somatic development under the gonadotropin and steroid control of folliculogenesis and ovulation.

reading_2.theme: Germ cell and gonadal development
reading_2.core_role: The shared pathways cover primordial germ cell migration, proliferation, survival and meiotic entry, plus Leydig differentiation and AMH/activin signalling. This is gonadal maturation within germ cell specification and male sex determination.

shared: Organic anion transport by SLC22 transporters

reading_1.theme: Urate and fructose transport
reading_1.core_role: The shared pathways are SLC2A9- and SLC22-mediated urate handling and its hypouricemia defects, framed as renal and intestinal urate transport linked to fructose uptake, which raises urate.

reading_2.theme: Renal epithelial solute transport: urate, amino acids, organic ions
reading_2.core_role: The shared pathways frame urate handling by SLC22 and SLC2A9 transporters (and renal hypouricemia) as one instance of polarized epithelial solute reabsorption in kidney and liver, alongside cystine and amino acid transport.

shared: positive regulation of voltage-gated calcium channel activity

reading_1.theme: Intracellular calcium signalling and store-operated entry
reading_1.core_role: The shared pathways describe cellular responses to calcium, calcium sequestration, caffeine-sensitive release and voltage-gated channel activation, framed as cytosolic calcium homeostasis through ER store release and store-operated entry.

reading_2.theme: Cytosolic calcium signalling and homeostasis
reading_2.core_role: The shared pathways cover calcium entry and store release (voltage-gated channels, caffeine-sensitive ryanodine release) and sequestration, which the theme balances with Na+/Ca2+ exchange to lower cytosolic calcium.

reading_1.theme: Glycine metabolism and glycine conjugation detoxification
reading_1.core_role: The shared pathways describe glycine synthesis and glyoxylate metabolism, framed as supplying glycine for mitochondrial conjugation and clearance of benzoate, salicylate and related xenobiotic acids.

reading_2.theme: Amino acid catabolism: aromatic, threonine and glycine pathways
reading_2.core_role: The shared glycine/glyoxylate pathways act as a downstream convergence point where threonine and other amino acid catabolism (alongside phenylalanine/tyrosine breakdown) generate or interconvert glycine.

shared: positive regulation of non-motile cilium assembly
Anchoring of the basal body to the plasma membrane

reading_1.theme: Centrosome, cilium and microtubule organization
reading_1.core_role: The shared pathways frame the centriole/basal body cycle, the switch between ciliogenesis (basal body docking, cilium assembly and disassembly) and centrosome duplication, within broader microtubule organizing-centre and spindle control.

reading_2.theme: Centriole, basal body and primary cilium biogenesis
reading_2.core_role: The shared pathways cover centriole duplication/elongation, basal body docking and cilium assembly/disassembly regulation, framed as the centriole-based foundation for ciliogenesis and intraflagellar ciliary trafficking.

shared: positive regulation of cytoplasmic mRNA processing body assembly
M-decay: degradation of maternal mRNAs by maternally stored factors
negative regulation of nuclear-transcribed mRNA catabolic process, deadenylation-dependent decay
Insulin-like Growth Factor-2 mRNA Binding Proteins (IGF2BPs/IMPs/VICKZs) bind RNA
nuclear-transcribed mRNA catabolic process, deadenylation-independent decay
regulation of nuclear-transcribed mRNA poly(A) tail shortening
positive regulation of nuclear-transcribed mRNA catabolic process, deadenylation-dependent decay

reading_1.theme: Post-transcriptional control of mRNA stability, decay and translation
reading_1.core_role: The shared pathways are the cytoplasmic mRNA turnover machinery (deadenylation, decapping, 5'-3' decay, P-bodies, 3'-UTR-mediated stabilization), serving here as the effector decay and stabilization step through which ARE-binding proteins and miRNA/siRNA silencing regulate gene expression.

reading_2.theme: Post-transcriptional mRNA decay and small RNA silencing
reading_2.core_role: The shared pathways are the cytoplasmic mRNA turnover machinery (deadenylation, decapping, 5'-3' decay, stabilization), the effector step through which miRNA silencing and ARE-binding proteins regulate mRNA fate.

shared: positive regulation of defense response to bacterium
Events associated with phagocytolytic activity of PMN cells
negative regulation of respiratory burst involved in inflammatory response

[untitled BTM module] These genes mark the differentiated tissue macrophage and microglial state, the resident phagocyte programme that clears debris and dying cells, handles iron and heme, and shapes local immune tone. Fc receptor gamma chain and the Tec kinase BTK couple immunoglobulin and immune-complex recognition to phagocytosis, while CYBB encodes the NADPH oxidase catalytic subunit gp91phox that generates the respiratory burst; its loss causes chronic granulomatous disease with recurrent bacterial and fungal infection.
regulation of killing of cells of another organism
positive regulation of reactive oxygen species biosynthetic process

reading_1.theme: Phagocyte respiratory burst and antimicrobial killing
reading_1.core_role: The shared pathways are NADPH oxidase respiratory burst, neutrophil degranulation and killing of bacteria and fungi, framed as the effector killing arm of myeloid inflammatory activation.

reading_2.theme: Phagocyte antimicrobial killing and host-pathogen interaction
reading_2.core_role: The shared pathways cover the phagocyte microbicidal effector arm: the NADPH oxidase respiratory burst and ROS, neutrophil degranulation and cytotoxicity against bacteria and fungi. Antimicrobial peptides complement this arm, and pathogen evasion strategies (blocking phagosome acidification, metal sequestration and others) counter it.

shared: negative regulation of very-low-density lipoprotein particle remodeling
NR1H2 & NR1H3 regulate gene expression linked to lipogenesis
NR1H2 & NR1H3 regulate gene expression linked to triglyceride lipolysis in adipose
NR1H2 & NR1H3 regulate gene expression linked to gluconeogenesis

reading_1.theme: LXR-mediated regulation of lipid and triglyceride metabolism
reading_1.core_role: The shared pathways describe LXR (NR1H2/NR1H3) transcriptional control of lipogenesis, lipolysis and gluconeogenesis, the nuclear receptor regulation of energy homeostasis integrated with insulin, AMPK and adiponectin signalling.

reading_2.theme: Nutrient-sensing control of lipid and energy metabolism
reading_2.core_role: The shared pathways are LXR (NR1H2/NR1H3) transcriptional control of lipogenesis, gluconeogenesis, adipose lipolysis and VLDL remodelling, framed as nuclear-receptor regulation of triglyceride and fatty acid homeostasis alongside AMPK, adiponectin and insulin signals.

shared: NR1H2 & NR1H3 regulate gene expression linked to gluconeogenesis
negative regulation of very-low-density lipoprotein particle remodeling
NR1H2 & NR1H3 regulate gene expression linked to triglyceride lipolysis in adipose
NR1H2 & NR1H3 regulate gene expression linked to lipogenesis

reading_1.theme: Nutrient-sensing control of lipid and energy metabolism
reading_1.core_role: The shared pathways are LXR (NR1H2/NR1H3) transcriptional control of lipogenesis, gluconeogenesis, adipose lipolysis and VLDL remodelling, framed as nuclear-receptor regulation of triglyceride and fatty acid homeostasis alongside AMPK, adiponectin and insulin signals.

reading_2.theme: LXR nuclear receptor control of lipid and glucose metabolism
reading_2.core_role: The shared pathways describe NR1H2/NR1H3 (LXR) target genes for lipogenesis, gluconeogenesis, lipolysis and VLDL remodelling, framed as nuclear-receptor transcriptional regulation of metabolism modulated by SUMOylation.

shared: TP53 Regulates Transcription of DNA Repair Genes
Regulation of TP53 Activity through Phosphorylation
Autodegradation of the E3 ubiquitin ligase COP1

reading_1.theme: p53 regulation in DNA damage response
reading_1.core_role: The shared pathways describe phosphorylation- and ubiquitin-dependent control of p53 stability and activity (and Cdc25A degradation), framed as the DNA damage checkpoint signalling governed by kinase/phosphatase balance.

reading_2.theme: p53 regulation by phosphorylation and ubiquitin degradation
reading_2.core_role: The shared pathways are the DNA-damage control of TP53 and checkpoint proteins, covering phosphorylation-driven p53 activation, MDM2/COP1-mediated p53 degradation and Cdc25A destruction, with p53-driven repair gene transcription, regulated by the kinase/phosphatase steps in the additional set.

reading_1.theme: Lipoprotein remodeling and cholesterol efflux
reading_1.core_role: The shared pathways are HDL and LDL particle remodeling, framed as plasma reverse cholesterol transport fed by ABC-transporter-mediated lipid efflux and HDL assembly.

reading_2.theme: Lipoprotein metabolism and intestinal lipid absorption
reading_2.core_role: The shared pathways describe LDL and HDL particle remodeling, framed as one stage of the lipoprotein life cycle running from dietary lipid absorption and chylomicron/VLDL assembly to lipase action and clearance.

reading_1.theme: Leukocyte adhesion and transendothelial migration
reading_1.core_role: The shared pathways describe neutrophil migration and diapedesis as the endpoint of integrin- and PECAM1-mediated adhesion that also governs T-cell extravasation, polarity and synapse formation.

reading_2.theme: Leukocyte adhesion and transendothelial migration
reading_2.core_role: The shared pathways are neutrophil migration, extravasation and diapedesis, the transendothelial migration step enabled by integrin and PECAM1-mediated leukocyte adhesion.

shared: positive regulation of myeloid leukocyte mediated immunity

reading_1.theme: Myeloid innate inflammatory activation and TLR regulation
reading_1.core_role: The shared pathways are the generic monocyte-driven inflammatory and myeloid effector response, which the theme places under control of TLR, CD40 and antigen-presentation signalling in dendritic cells and monocytes.

reading_2.theme: Monocyte and neutrophil inflammatory activation
reading_2.core_role: The shared pathways are monocyte signatures, inflammatory response and myeloid immunity, framed as myeloid leukocyte activation including neutrophil degranulation and complement signalling.

reading_1.theme: Peroxisomal fatty acid oxidation
reading_1.core_role: The shared pathways are peroxisome maintenance and cofactor/acyl-CoA handling (fission, TYSND1 processing, NAD transport, medium-chain and malonyl-CoA metabolism) that support peroxisomal alpha- and beta-oxidation of fatty acids.

reading_2.theme: Peroxisomal fatty acid oxidation and peroxisome function
reading_2.core_role: The shared pathways capture peroxisome biology itself (fission, TYSND1 protease processing, NAD transport, medium-chain acyl-CoA and malonyl-CoA handling) as the organelle housekeeping that supports peroxisomal alpha- and beta-oxidation.

shared: positive regulation of extrinsic apoptotic signaling pathway via death domain receptors
negative regulation of hepatocyte apoptotic process
positive regulation of thymocyte apoptotic process
negative regulation of extrinsic apoptotic signaling pathway via death domain receptors
Microbial modulation of RIPK1-mediated regulated necrosis
negative regulation of tumor necrosis factor-mediated signaling pathway
regulation of activation-induced cell death of T cells
Activation, myristolyation of BID and translocation to mitochondria
negative regulation of Fas signaling pathway
SARS-CoV-1-mediated effects on programmed cell death

reading_1.theme: Death receptor-mediated apoptosis and necroptosis
reading_1.core_role: The shared pathways describe Fas/TRAIL/TNF death-receptor signalling, caspase-8 activation and its control by c-FLIP, and RIPK1/TRIF necroptosis, framed here as the extrinsic cell-death machinery used in immune killing, T cell deletion and anti-tumour/allograft responses.

reading_2.theme: Apoptosis via death receptors and the mitochondrial pathway
reading_2.core_role: The shared pathways are the extrinsic arm of cell death, death-receptor (Fas, TRAIL, TNF, TLR3/TRIF) signalling through caspase-8, c-FLIP and RIPK1 necroptosis, which via BID cleavage feeds the mitochondrial BCL-2/apoptosome execution pathway.

reading_1.theme: Glycan trimming and lysosomal glycoconjugate degradation
reading_1.core_role: The shared pathways are glycosidase-mediated N-glycan processing and lysosomal oligosaccharide catabolism, framed as glycoside hydrolysis in line with lysosomal ganglioside and glycosphingolipid breakdown.

reading_2.theme: N-glycan processing and amino sugar/mannose metabolism
reading_2.core_role: The shared pathways are glycosidase-mediated N-glycan trimming in the ER and lysosomal oligosaccharide breakdown (with their CDG/MRT defects), framed as glycan processing and turnover that feeds monosaccharide metabolism.

shared: Defective RHAG causes regulator type Rh-null hemolytic anemia (RHN)

reading_1.theme: Erythrocyte membrane and gas transport
reading_1.core_role: The shared pathways describe Rh-associated membrane transport proteins (RHAG, Rh-null anaemia), framed as erythrocyte membrane components serving red cell exchange of oxygen, carbon dioxide and nitric oxide.

reading_2.theme: Rhesus glycoprotein-mediated ammonium and CO2 transport
reading_2.core_role: The shared pathways cover biosynthesis of Rh blood group/RHAG membrane proteins and Rh-null disease. Here they are the gas-channel machinery that moves ammonia/ammonium and carbon dioxide across epithelial and erythrocyte membranes.

shared: positive regulation of neuroepithelial cell differentiation

reading_1.theme: Neural plate patterning and early neural induction
reading_1.core_role: The shared pathways describe neural plate regionalization and neuroepithelial differentiation, framed as the core of early axial and border patterning that specifies anterior/posterior neural plate and neural crest.

reading_2.theme: Early embryonic axis and neural plate patterning
reading_2.core_role: The shared pathways are neural plate regionalization and neuroepithelial differentiation, the neural patterning outcome of embryonic axis specification and neural plate border formation.

reading_1.theme: Amino acid and organic acid catabolism via glycine
reading_1.core_role: The shared pathways describe threonine and general L-amino acid breakdown converging on glycine and glyoxylate, here extended to alanine metabolism as a related transamination route.

reading_2.theme: Threonine, glycine and small amino acid catabolism
reading_2.core_role: The shared pathways are threonine catabolism to glycine and glyoxylate metabolism, read as amino acid degradation and interconversion within organic-acid metabolism, extended by alanine metabolism.

shared: Loss of Nlp from mitotic centrosomes
Recruitment of NuMA to mitotic centrosomes
Recruitment of mitotic centrosome proteins and complexes

reading_1.theme: Mitotic spindle assembly and cytokinesis
reading_1.core_role: The shared pathways are centrosome maturation and Aurora A/TPX2-driven spindle assembly, the early-mitosis spindle-building stage that precedes spindle elongation, checkpoint control and cytokinesis.

reading_2.theme: Centrosome organisation and mitotic spindle assembly
reading_2.core_role: The shared pathways cover mitotic centrosome maturation, AURKA activation by TPX2 and NuMA recruitment, framed as building the spindle through centrosome-based microtubule nucleation and anchoring.

reading_1.theme: RNA modification in ribosome and translation machinery biogenesis
reading_1.core_role: The shared pathways are the mitochondrial instance of the theme: rRNA/mRNA modification and mitoribosome subunit assembly enabling mitochondrial translation, set against the broader nuclear-cytosolic tRNA, rRNA and snRNA modification machinery.

reading_2.theme: Mitochondrial gene expression: mtDNA, transcription, RNA processing, translation
reading_2.core_role: The shared pathways frame mitoribosome assembly, mitochondrial rRNA/mRNA modification and translation regulation as the translational arm of mitochondrial gene expression downstream of mtDNA replication, transcription and RNA processing.

reading_1.theme: Transition metal ion homeostasis
reading_1.core_role: The shared pathways are copper and manganese import, transport, detoxification and ceruloplasmin function, framed as one part of broader transition metal handling that includes iron export and cobalt transport.

reading_2.theme: Transition metal ion transport and homeostasis
reading_2.core_role: The shared pathways describe copper and manganese uptake, homeostasis and detoxification, including ceruloplasmin deficiency, framed as metal handling linked to iron export defects in hemochromatosis.

reading_1.theme: Water-soluble vitamin and cofactor metabolism
reading_1.core_role: The shared pathways cover riboflavin, thiamine, choline and carnitine metabolism and transport, framed as part of a broad vitamin/cofactor metabolism theme alongside cobalamin, folate, biotin and methionine one-carbon pathways.

reading_2.theme: B-vitamin, choline and carnitine micronutrient metabolism
reading_2.core_role: The shared pathways cover uptake and metabolism of riboflavin, thiamine, choline and carnitine, framed as one-carbon/trimethylamine nutrient handling in which FMO-mediated oxidation (TMAU) and carnitine transport complete the picture.

reading_1.theme: Amino acid catabolism and transsulfuration
reading_1.core_role: The shared pathways are transsulfuration and sulfur amino acid (homocysteine-cysteine, serine) catabolism, one branch within broad amino acid metabolism including aromatic, proline and threonine catabolism.

reading_2.theme: Amino acid catabolism and interconversion, sulfur and aromatic
reading_2.core_role: The shared pathways are the sulfur-amino-acid branch of general amino acid breakdown, covering transsulfuration of homocysteine to cysteine, cysteine and serine catabolism, and sulfonate handling, which sit beside the aromatic, proline, threonine and glycine/glyoxylate catabolic routes.

shared: Defective SLC4A1 causes hereditary spherocytosis type 4 (HSP4),  distal renal tubular acidosis (dRTA) and dRTA with hemolytic anemia (dRTA-HA)
Defective SLC4A4 causes renal tubular acidosis, proximal, with ocular abnormalities and mental retardation (pRTA-OA)

reading_1.theme: SLC anion and ion transporters and their disorders in mineralization
reading_1.core_role: The shared pathways describe SLC4 bicarbonate transport and its defects in renal tubular acidosis, framed as part of a wider set of SLC ion transporters (phosphate, calcium exchangers) governing pH and mineralization of tooth enamel and tissues.

reading_2.theme: Ion transport in acid-base balance and mineralization
reading_2.core_role: The shared pathways are SLC4 bicarbonate transport (AE1, NBCe1) and its disease defects, framed as ion transport for acid-base handling and pH control that supports tissue mineralization alongside phosphate and calcium transporters.

reading_1.theme: NAD+ metabolism from tryptophan and nicotinate
reading_1.core_role: The shared pathways cover NAD+ salvage from nicotinate/pyridine nucleotides and NAD+ breakdown. They are the salvage counterpart to de novo NAD+ synthesis through kynurenine, tied to redox state and methylglyoxal/glycation defence.

reading_2.theme: NAD+ metabolism from tryptophan and niacin
reading_2.core_role: The shared pathways are niacin-based pyridine nucleotide salvage and NAD+ turnover, the salvage complement to de novo NAD+ synthesis from tryptophan via kynurenine, in a context of redox and aldehyde detoxification.

reading_1.theme: Rho-family GTPase cycles and cytoskeletal signalling
reading_1.core_role: The shared pathways describe the CDC42, RAC3, RHOG and RHOJ GTPase cycles and G-beta-gamma-CDC42 signalling, framed here as core small-GTPase switches whose effectors (formins, IQGAPs) and atypical Rho members regulate actin and focal adhesion dynamics.

reading_2.theme: Rho family GTPase signalling to the actin cytoskeleton
reading_2.core_role: The shared pathways are the CDC42, RHOG, RHOJ and RAC3 GTPase cycles, framed as the switch-level signalling that activates WASP/WAVE and Arp2/3 to build lamellipodia.

shared: Signaling by activated point mutants of FGFR3

reading_1.theme: FGFR1/FGFR3 activation and downstream signalling
reading_1.core_role: The shared pathways are FGFR1/FGFR3 ligand binding and FRS/SHC cascades, including activating FGFR3 mutants, framed as the receptor signal regulated by Spry and FGFRL1 feedback.

reading_2.theme: FGFR1/FGFR3 signalling and its regulation
reading_2.core_role: The shared pathways cover ligand activation and FRS2/SHC adaptor-driven downstream cascades of FGFR1 and FGFR3, including activating mutants. Sprouty and FGFRL1 provide feedback tuning of this signalling.

shared: PDH complex synthesizes acetyl-CoA from PYR
Loss-of-function mutations in DLD cause MSUD3/DLDD

reading_1.theme: Lipoylated 2-oxoacid dehydrogenases and mitochondrial TCA cycle
reading_1.core_role: The shared pathways are the lipoate-dependent 2-oxoacid dehydrogenase complexes (PDH, OGDH, OADH, glycine cleavage) and their DLD subunit feeding the TCA cycle, framed here as the mitochondrial oxidative core linked to succinate dehydrogenase, iron-sulfur cluster assembly and ATP synthesis.

reading_2.theme: Mitochondrial 2-oxoacid dehydrogenases and TCA cycle
reading_2.core_role: The shared pathways describe the lipoylated PDH, OGDH and OADH complexes feeding the TCA cycle and lysine/glycine degradation, framed as the oxidative core connected to Fe-S cluster maturation, succinate dehydrogenase and ATP synthesis.

reading_1.theme: Amino acid catabolism through glyoxylate and glycine metabolism
reading_1.core_role: The shared pathways cover generic L-amino acid and amide catabolic/metabolic processes. Here they are the broad organic-acid degradation that converges on glyoxylate and glycine interconversion, including breakdown of non-proteinogenic amino acids.

reading_2.theme: Amino acid and organic acid catabolism
reading_2.core_role: The shared pathways are the generic L-amino acid metabolic and catabolic terms (plus amide catabolism) that frame this theme as broad amino acid breakdown, with glyoxylate and glycine metabolism as specific organic-acid outlets.

reading_1.theme: Amyloid-beta production, fibrillisation and clearance
reading_1.core_role: The shared pathways are about amyloid proteostasis: amyloid fibril formation, APP processing and amyloid-beta clearance. The additional pathways place this in the early and recycling endosomes, where APP is processed and amyloid-beta is cleared.

reading_2.theme: Amyloid-beta production, aggregation and clearance
reading_2.core_role: The shared pathways describe APP processing control, amyloid fibril formation and amyloid-beta clearance, framed here with endosomal trafficking as the compartment where APP and amyloid-beta are handled.

reading_1.theme: Protein glycosylation and nucleotide-sugar supply
reading_1.core_role: The shared pathways cover N-glycan assembly and processing (dolichol-glucose, mannose trimming, hybrid/complex branching, LacNAc elongation, sialylation). This is the protein-glycan building arm, fed by nucleotide-sugar synthesis and Golgi transport, alongside O-glycan and blood-group glycan synthesis and the CDG disorders.

reading_2.theme: Protein glycosylation and nucleotide-sugar metabolism
reading_2.core_role: The shared pathways are the N-glycan processing and elongation steps, mannose trimming, antennae elongation, sialylation and poly-LacNAc addition, which consume the nucleotide sugars whose synthesis, transport and disease defects fill out the theme.

shared: positive regulation of microglial cell activation
negative regulation of microglial cell activation

reading_1.theme: Amyloid-beta handling and glial activation in neurodegeneration
reading_1.core_role: The shared pathways describe regulation of amyloid-beta production and clearance, tau tangle assembly and microglial/astrocyte activation, i.e. the Alzheimer-type neuroinflammatory and proteinopathy processes that the additional amyloid fibril and clearance terms extend.

reading_2.theme: Amyloid-beta and glial regulation in neurodegeneration
reading_2.core_role: The shared pathways are regulation of amyloid-beta formation and clearance, neurofibrillary tangle assembly and microglia/astrocyte activation, framed as the pathological processes of Alzheimer-type neurodegeneration.

shared: negative regulation of sister chromatid cohesion

reading_1.theme: Sister chromatid cohesion during mitosis
reading_1.core_role: The shared pathways cover release of cohesion and progression through mitosis. This is the resolution end of a cohesin cycle that runs through loading, establishment, maintenance and separation.

reading_2.theme: Cohesin-mediated sister chromatid cohesion and its resolution
reading_2.core_role: The shared pathways frame mitotic cell-cycle progression and negative control of cohesion as the timed release of cohesin-held sister chromatids, within a theme of cohesin loading, establishment, maintenance and separation.

shared: negative regulation of cellular response to oxidative stress
regulation of mitochondrial electron transport, NADH to ubiquinone
regulation of mitochondrial ATP synthesis coupled electron transport
negative regulation of reactive oxygen species biosynthetic process
positive regulation of nucleotide biosynthetic process

reading_1.theme: Regulation of mitochondrial respiration and oxidative stress
reading_1.core_role: The shared pathways are direct control of oxidative phosphorylation, electron transport, ATP synthesis and ROS output, framed as the bioenergetic set point that governs cellular stress responses to hypoxia, drugs and apoptotic cues.

reading_2.theme: Mitochondrial respiration, oxidative stress and cell death
reading_2.core_role: The shared pathways frame regulation of oxidative phosphorylation, electron transport and ROS production as the mitochondrial metabolic source of oxidative stress that governs apoptosis, ferroptosis and ischemic injury.

shared: Expression of BMAL (ARNTL), CLOCK, and NPAS2
RORA,B,C and NR1D1 (REV-ERBA) regulate gene expression
NPAS4 regulates expression of target genes

reading_1.theme: Nuclear receptor and circadian control of metabolism
reading_1.core_role: The shared pathways cover PPAR, thyroid and ROR/REV-ERB nuclear receptors, PGC-1alpha and the BMAL1-CLOCK circadian clock, framed as transcriptional regulation of metabolism and mitochondrial biogenesis.

reading_2.theme: Circadian and nuclear receptor control of metabolism
reading_2.core_role: The shared pathways describe the circadian clock and nuclear receptor transcription (PPARA, ROR/REV-ERB, PGC-1alpha), framed as transcriptional control of metabolism and mitochondrial biogenesis in response to nutrient and redox state.

shared: negative regulation of CD4-positive, alpha-beta T cell proliferation
regulation of CD4-positive, CD25-positive, alpha-beta regulatory T cell differentiation
negative regulation of activated T cell proliferation
positive regulation of regulatory T cell differentiation
negative regulation of T-helper 17 cell lineage commitment
negative regulation of CD8-positive, alpha-beta T cell activation
negative regulation of type II interferon production
negative regulation of T cell cytokine production

reading_1.theme: T cell tolerance and regulatory T cell suppression
reading_1.core_role: The shared pathways cover regulatory T cell differentiation and suppression of effector T cell proliferation and cytokine production, framed as mechanisms of peripheral tolerance and anergy.

reading_2.theme: Regulatory T cell-mediated suppression of T cell responses
reading_2.core_role: The shared pathways are the suppression of effector T cell activation, proliferation and IFN-gamma/Th17 output together with induction of regulatory T cells, i.e. the tolerance arm of T cell costimulatory regulation.

shared: Regulation of gene expression in early pancreatic precursor cells
Developmental Lineage of Multipotent Pancreatic Progenitor Cells
Developmental Lineage of Pancreatic Endocrine Mid Progenitor Cells

reading_1.theme: Pancreatic endocrine lineage development
reading_1.core_role: The shared pathways are the progenitor stages of pancreatic lineage specification and their transcriptional control, the early steps leading to endocrine (and exocrine) cell differentiation.

reading_2.theme: Pancreatic progenitor lineage and endocrine differentiation
reading_2.core_role: The shared pathways are the transcriptional lineage programme of early multipotent and endocrine-progenitor pancreatic cells, including transdifferentiation, which lead into NEUROG3-driven endocrine (alpha cell) and exocrine differentiation.

shared: positive regulation of chemokine (C-C motif) ligand 5 production
positive regulation of dendritic cell cytokine production
positive regulation of cGAS/STING signaling pathway

reading_1.theme: Innate sensing and chemokine defence against intracellular pathogens
reading_1.core_role: The shared pathways cover cGAS-STING activation, CCL5 and STAT6-induced chemokines and dendritic cell cytokine production, framed as host defence against intracellular pathogens with GBP and inflammasome effectors.

reading_2.theme: Dendritic cell innate activation and Th1 priming
reading_2.core_role: The shared pathways are innate sensing and dendritic cell cytokine and chemokine production (cGAS-STING, response to protozoa, CCL5, STAT6 chemokines), framed as the trigger that leads to IL-12 and IFN-gamma driven Th1 responses.

shared: positive regulation of mesenchymal stem cell differentiation
positive regulation of mesenchymal stem cell proliferation

reading_1.theme: Morphogen control of mesenchymal progenitors: Wnt, BMP, TGF-beta
reading_1.core_role: The shared pathways frame Wnt signalling as one morphogen arm driving mesenchymal stem cell expansion and differentiation, alongside BMP/SMAD1 and TGF-beta/activin SMAD2/3 signalling toward skeletal fates.

reading_2.theme: Wnt-driven mesenchymal stem cell osteoblast differentiation
reading_2.core_role: The shared pathways are Wnt signalling promoting mesenchymal stem cell proliferation and differentiation, framed as the upstream drive of osteoblast proliferation and differentiation in bone formation.

shared: Regulation of PLK1 Activity at G2/M Transition
Recruitment of mitotic centrosome proteins and complexes
Loss of Nlp from mitotic centrosomes
Recruitment of NuMA to mitotic centrosomes
FBXL7 down-regulates AURKA during mitotic entry and in early mitosis

reading_1.theme: Mitotic centrosome and spindle assembly regulated by Aurora A/PLK1
reading_1.core_role: The shared pathways are the Aurora A/TPX2 and PLK1 kinase control of centrosome maturation and spindle assembly at mitotic entry, framed as the core of a broader spindle-formation and checkpoint machinery including Ran, NEK kinases and kinetochore signalling.

reading_2.theme: Mitotic spindle formation and centrosome regulation
reading_2.core_role: The shared pathways describe Aurora A- and PLK1-regulated centrosome maturation and spindle assembly at the G2/M transition, framed as the core of mitotic progression including centrosome duplication and spindle checkpoint control.

reading_1.theme: Sulfur amino acid and selenium metabolism
reading_1.core_role: The shared pathways are transsulfuration and cysteine/sulfur amino acid catabolism, framed as the chalcogen amino-acid pathway that also processes selenium compounds.

reading_2.theme: Amino acid catabolism and transsulfuration
reading_2.core_role: The shared pathways are transsulfuration and sulfur amino acid (homocysteine-cysteine, serine) catabolism, one branch within broad amino acid metabolism including aromatic, proline and threonine catabolism.

reading_1.theme: Peroxisomal fatty acid oxidation
reading_1.core_role: The shared pathways are peroxisome maintenance and cofactor/acyl-CoA handling (fission, TYSND1 processing, NAD transport, medium-chain and malonyl-CoA metabolism) that support peroxisomal alpha- and beta-oxidation of fatty acids.

reading_2.theme: Peroxisomal and mitochondrial acyl-CoA and NADP(H) metabolism
reading_2.core_role: The shared pathways (NADP+ synthesis, NAD transport, malonyl-/succinyl-/medium-chain acyl-CoA metabolism, peroxisome fission and TYSND1 processing) are framed here as organellar cofactor and acyl-CoA metabolism that supplies NADPH via isocitrate dehydrogenase, with IDH-mutant 2-hydroxyglutarate as the disease link.

shared: positive regulation of multicellular organism growth
negative regulation of multicellular organism growth

reading_1.theme: Leptin-ghrelin control of feeding and growth
reading_1.core_role: The shared pathways are leptin signalling and regulation of body growth, framed as hormonal energy-balance control linking appetite and feeding behaviour to somatic growth.

reading_2.theme: Hormonal control of organism growth
reading_2.core_role: The shared pathways are leptin signalling and regulation of body growth, framed as part of the growth hormone/IGF JAK-STAT axis controlling organismal growth.

shared: negative regulation of ERK1 and ERK2 cascade
Negative feedback regulation of MAPK pathway
negative regulation of Ras protein signal transduction

reading_1.theme: ERK/MAPK activation and negative feedback
reading_1.core_role: The shared pathways are ERK-cascade negative feedback, dephosphorylation and RSK activation, framed as the termination and downstream output arm of ERK1/ERK2 activation.

reading_2.theme: RAS-MAPK signalling and its negative feedback
reading_2.core_role: The shared pathways describe negative feedback on RAS-ERK signalling (phosphatases, RSK, Ras inhibition), framed as the brake on a cascade driven by oncogenic RAS, RAF and MAP2K mutants.

reading_1.theme: Neurotransmitter transport and synaptic vesicle loading
reading_1.core_role: The shared pathways describe SLC-mediated neurotransmitter transport, vesicle loading and glycine transporter disease, framed here as part of the uptake and packaging cycle that includes monoamine reuptake transporters and vesicle acidification, with their transporter disorders.

reading_2.theme: Neurotransmitter transport and reuptake at synapses
reading_2.core_role: The shared pathways describe SLC-mediated vesicular loading and transport of neurotransmitters (including glycine transporter defects), framed as the transport machinery for glutamate, GABA and glycine reuptake and astrocytic recycling.

shared: obsolete vesicle targeting, rough ER to cis-Golgi
obsolete vesicle targeting, to, from or within Golgi

reading_1.theme: Vesicle targeting in ER-Golgi trafficking
reading_1.core_role: The shared pathways describe vesicle targeting between ER and Golgi, framed as the targeting step of COPI/COPII-mediated anterograde and retrograde early secretory traffic.

reading_2.theme: Vesicle targeting and tethering in ER-Golgi transport
reading_2.core_role: The shared pathways are vesicle targeting to and within the Golgi from the rough ER, framed here as the destination-recognition step of early secretory traffic that precedes vesicle tethering at the Golgi.

shared: Defective binding of VWF variant to GPIb:IX:V
Defective VWF binding to collagen type I
Enhanced binding of GP1BA variant to VWF multimer:collagen
Enhanced cleavage of VWF variant by ADAMTS13
Defective VWF cleavage by ADAMTS13 variant

reading_1.theme: Blood coagulation, von Willebrand factor and fibrinolysis
reading_1.core_role: The shared pathways are the primary hemostasis step, VWF binding to collagen and platelet GPIb with ADAMTS13 cleavage and their variants, framed as part of coagulation alongside the factor VIII/IX/V cascade defects, contact activation and fibrin formation and dissolution.

reading_2.theme: Hemostasis: VWF-platelet adhesion, coagulation and fibrinolysis
reading_2.core_role: The shared pathways are von Willebrand factor-mediated primary hemostasis (VWF binding to GPIb and collagen, ADAMTS13 cleavage) and its disease variants, coupled to the coagulation factor cascade and fibrinolysis.

shared: protein localization to perinuclear region of cytoplasm
obsolete proteolysis involved in protein catabolic process

reading_1.theme: Protein quality control and selective autophagy
reading_1.core_role: The shared pathways cover misfolded-protein responses, Josephin-domain deubiquitinases and reticulophagy, framed as proteostasis through ubiquitin-dependent ERAD and selective autophagy of organelles.

reading_2.theme: Misfolded protein aggregation and its autophagic clearance
reading_2.core_role: The shared pathways describe misfolded-protein recognition, oligomerization, perinuclear sequestration and Josephin DUB/ER-phagy processing, framed as the protein-quality-control front end that feeds aggregates into aggrephagy and chaperone-mediated autophagy.

reading_1.theme: Golgi-endosome membrane trafficking
reading_1.core_role: The shared pathways are the cargo routes between plasma membrane, Golgi and endosomes (endocytosis, constitutive secretion, receptor recycling, Golgi targeting), framed as the trafficking outputs carried out by membrane budding and tubulation machinery.

reading_2.theme: Golgi-endosome membrane trafficking and recycling
reading_2.core_role: The shared pathways cover cargo routing between the Golgi, endosomes and plasma membrane (constitutive secretion, endocytosis, receptor recycling). Here this routing is carried out through Golgi vesicle budding and membrane tubulation.
